sections.label: Urinary
Male
sections.text:
Drawing in of testicles and spermatic cord.
Pain worse during passage of pungent smelling urine.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Pain in region of kidneys ; better lying bent
backward. General fatigue.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Apocyn.; Ars.; Coffea
(similar botanically and in relieving effects of fatigue).
